text: Over 23 hours, BAM’s Solana stake share fell 0.03 percentage points, while the 7 day view is still up 0.19 percentage points at 34.5%. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 21.8% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. Leadership changes remain whale-driven routing, not a validated structural rollover.
